247:t_1:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...How long has it been since we got separated from $c...?」

247:t_1:9.en:
$n
「We're sending a distress signal. I'm sure $c will find us.」

247:t_1:10.en:
$n
「That $$時空震動$$ threw us here, so everyone else should be nearby, too.」

247:t_1:12.en:
$n
「It'll be all right, Miss $$スズネ$$. There's no way $$ＡＧ$$ would abandon his prized $$ジェニオン$$.」

247:t_1:13.en:
$n
「He'll use that dimensional merchant information network he's so proud of, or whatever it takes, to find us.」

247:t_1:15.en:
$n
「There's an emergency survival kit in the $$ジェニオン$$, and our suits... um...」

247:t_1:16.en:
$n
「...a-also have a function to automatically break down waste and teleport it away...」

247:t_1:17.en:
$n
「As a last resort, we can use the cold sleep function.」

247:t_1:23.en:
$n
「I was... wondering whether $$宗介$$ is safe...」

247:t_1:25.en:
$n
「It wasn't just $$宗介$$... I was thinking about everyone in $c... and Earth.」

247:t_1:26.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're thinking of them even though we don't know what will happen to us...?」

247:t_1:27.en:
$n
「I can do something about myself by taking action.」

247:t_1:28.en:
$n
「But when it comes to other people... all I can do is wait...」

247:t_1:29.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're staying positive even in this situation...」

247:t_1:30.en:
$n
「You and everyone else taught me that, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

247:t_1:32.en:
$n
「Everyone gets down sometimes. So right now, I'll protect you.」

247:t_1:33.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...You've been protecting me ever since you started piloting the $$ジェニオン$$, $n.」

247:t_1:34.en:
$n
「That's not true. I'm the one you've been protecting.」

247:t_1:35.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We protect each other... I think that's what partners do...」

247:t_1:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「In my case, my sense of responsibility as a teacher adds to it, too.」

247:t_1:37.en:
$n
「But the special teaching practicum is over now, right? Yesterday was supposed to be the closing ceremony.」

247:t_1:38.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Then will you call me $$スズネ$$ from now on?」

247:t_1:40.en:
$$スズネ$$
「If we keep wandering through space together and reach some planet, shall we become its Adam and Eve?」

247:t_1:43.en:
$n
「That's not it, but I'm not ready for it...!」

247:t_1:46.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I'm joking. Did that cheer you up a little?」

247:t_1:47.en:
$n
「You mean cheer me up...? You were the one feeling down, $$スズネ$$.」

247:t_1:51.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you, $n. Lately... you've been helping me all the time.」

247:t_1:55.en:
$n
「...I've kept thinking about what I could do with the $$ジェニオン$$, after everyone helped me so much...」

247:t_1:56.en:
$n
「My answer was to fight to grow stronger so I could protect someone, but...」

247:t_1:57.en:
$n
「Lately, I've started to understand a little that what I lacked was strength in the truest sense.」

247:t_1:59.en:
$n
「I have to do what I must, without clinging to convenient hopes or lashing out in despair...」

247:t_1:60.en:
$n
「I think... when I can do that, I'll become stronger.」

247:t_1:61.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Do you mean what happened back at $$ラース・バビロン$$...?」

247:t_1:62.en:
$n
「In that moment... I felt like I'd overcome something, just a little.」

247:t_1:63.en:
$n
(If I can gain that strength, then surely, with Mom, too...)

247:t_1:64.en:
$$スズネ$$
「There's a proximity alert...! Has $c come for us...?!」

247:t_1:65.en:
$n
「...There's no identification signal... At least, it isn't $c.」

247:t_1:67.en:
$n
「There are so many... and they're so fast... We can't escape them.」

247:t_1:69.en:
$n
「I don't know what's coming, but we'll have to make contact.」

247:t_1:70.en:
$n
「For now, let's do everything we can to stay alive.」

247:t_1:71.en:
$$スズネ$$
($n is scared, too... But he's probably trying to keep me from worrying...)

248:t_000:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank goodness... You were unconscious all this time...」

248:t_000:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...I checked the $$ジェニオン$$'s data, but... it seems we're outside the $$地球圏$$...」

248:t_000:7.en:
$n
「Then we... were thrown here by that $$時空震動$$...」

248:t_000:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yeah... It looks like we're... adrift in space...」

247:t_1:56: The protagonist introduces a contrast between physical fighting strength and true strength; the thought continues in57.
247:t_1:63: The thought connects future strength with his mother but withholds the intended result; no later plot inference is supplied.
247:t_1:68: Suzune begins asking what to do when escape is impossible, but the protagonist supplies the plan in69.

247:t_1:48: Dropped Miss explicitly preserves the source honorific joke; Miss is present in earlier addresses, then omitted in47.
